subject: Taxes
title: Deadlines, Reminders, and Timing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Deadlines, Reminders, and Timing.

hook.text: Simply sending a text reminder one week before a tax deadline increases on-time payment by 8–10%.

buildup.text: Many late payments aren't intentional evasion—they're forgetfulness, procrastination, or inattention.

discovery.text: Spreading deadlines across the year—quarterly estimated payments.

twist.text: Time-of-day matters too. People are more honest in the morning.

climax.text: Smart timing—well-placed reminders, split deadlines, morning prompts.

punchline.text: A text message, 8% more payments. Timing beats threats.

quiz.question: How much do text reminders increase on-time tax payment?
